contradictions.what: Dana says the customer was building a portal, then says Paul's team isn't building anything and the portal is off the shelf with a plugin.
Dana first says the evaluation was about the portal (per the inbound), then says the portal was the excuse and the real trigger was the new CFO's close problem.
Dana says 'Not much' changed in the questions after the bank call, then describes a new question from Ines about a named contact.
Dana says the first proposal stalled three weeks, later says she lost a month pitching the portal; durations differ and may not be the same period.
Ines said 'go back' and asked to see it with her data, but Dana says she had the deal at 20 percent and 'dead' before the following meeting.
Dana says 'After that it was paperwork', but also that Ines brought up the missing distributor reference twice, so a gap stayed live.

dodges.what: Answered 'Kind of?' before giving the real trigger, which was the CFO's close problem.
